testcase.name: Scenario: Show active member parameter values in the table tree: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1440:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show active member parameter values in the table tree ✔ Given The MCAD Software has model states Primary and Copy State ✔ And the table includes length parameter d0 and angular parameter d1 ✔ And Primary has d0 equal to 1 in and d1 equal to 0 degrees ✔ And Copy State has d0 equal to "1 in + 0.5 in" and d1 equal to 5 degrees ✔ When the user activates Primary and opens the model-state table ✔ Then the Primary row is highlighted pale green as the active member ✔ And the parameter tree shows d0 at 1 in and d1 at 0 degrees ✔ And the Copy State row still shows its length expression and 5 degree angle
